## Compatibility policy
The packages are tested against DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`, Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`, and pnpm `>=10`. The p
i-ai package also targets `@earendil-works/pi-ai@0.82.1`. File patches refuse untested versions or s
tructural mismatches. The event-based and client-only shims do not patch upstream files but still re
ly on rc.6 contracts.
